title: Ashbury Rewards Elite Status Rules: Length Credits on Long Award Stays
content:
**Rule.** An Ashbury Rewards award stay — a completed Reward Night Rate stay credited to the membership — of seven or more nights stayed carries two length credits, an award stay of four to six nights stayed carries one length credit, and a shorter award stay carries none. The length credits are elite night credits added to the night credits posted for that award stay, and they are credits the award stay is owed, never an excess over its nights stayed.

**Nights stayed.** The nights stayed on the award stay are the whole calendar days from its actual check-in date to its actual check-out date, both read from the stay's Room Reservations record.

## Length credits by nights stayed

| Nights stayed on the award stay | Length credits |
|---|---|
| 1 to 3 | None |
| 4 to 6 | 1 |
| 7 or more | 2 |

The two thresholds are 4 and 7 nights stayed: 3 nights stayed carries none and 4 carries 1; 6 nights stayed carries 1 and 7 carries 2.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical stays)

| Actual check-in | Actual check-out | Nights stayed | Length credits |
|---|---|---|---|
| 10 June | 13 June | 3 | None |
| 10 June | 14 June | 4 | 1 |
| 10 June | 16 June | 6 | 1 |
| 10 June | 17 June | 7 | 2 |
| 28 June | 9 July | 11 | 2 |

A guest booked for eight nights who checked out after five nights stayed has five nights stayed on the Room Reservations record and carries 1 length credit.
